name: Run Checklist
description: A collapsible checklist that shows how far an agent has got through a task with several steps.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps in order. Done steps take a pine check, the running step sits in a raised row with a spinner, and pending steps fade toward the bottom when there are three or more.

props.name: title
props.description: Name of the task, shown in the header before the count of steps left.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the steps are shown at first (uncontrolled).

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the collapse button is pressed.

props.name: summary
props.description: Replaces the count of steps left in the header, for example to say where a run stopped.

props.name: strikeDone
props.description: Strikes through done steps as well as dimming them.

props.name: outcome
props.description: Turns the header ring into a run mark: a progress arc while running, a full ring with a check when done, and a small square when stopped. After a stop, steps that never ran stay dimmed.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Other props go to the root section element.
